notes: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is English-trained. Persian/Arabic-script utterances are intentionally routed to Dina's safe Persian rules.

choices.description: The user asks for the current local clock time.
The user asks for today's calendar date.
The user wants to control media volume or sound level.
examples: Set the volume to fifty percent.

choices.description: The user wants to control screen brightness.

time_date.prompt: Choose which time or date information the user requests.

choices.description: Return the current local clock time.

audio.prompt: Choose the requested audio or volume operation.

choices.description: Increase or turn up the media volume.
Decrease or turn down the media volume.
Set the media volume to a specific target value or percentage.
examples: Put the volume at level five.

choices.description: Mute or silence the media audio.
Unmute or restore the media audio.

display.prompt: Choose the requested screen brightness operation.

choices.description: Set screen brightness to a specific target percentage.
examples: Set the screen brightness to 30 percent.
